checks: A_max > A_min > nominal screw diameter and B_max > A_max in every row; W_min > T_min in every row
all five columns never decrease with size (monotone from #2 to 2 in); T_min, W_min step from 0.020/0.035 (#2) to 0.422/0.427 (2 in)
boltport, globalfastener and aftfasteners agree on every cell of the 24 published rows (3 sources; baden adds a 4th for #6-9/16)
for 1-5/8 .. 3 in (not published) T and W flatten (0.389/0.424 ... 0.458/0.491) as in the standard
shape_hint: A split ring (helical lock washer): a flat-ish coil of rectangular/trapezoidal wire cut open at one point, one turn, so the ends are offset along the axis; in a 2D top view it is a ring with a small radial slit, outer diameter B, inner diameter A (radial wall about (B-A)/2, close to W).

role_map.d_nom_note: nominal screw size (number size or fraction of an inch)
role_map.T_min: minimum mean section thickness (ti+to)/2 (axial height of the wire section)
role_map.W_min: minimum section width (radial width of the wire section)

notes: ASME B18.21.1 regular series only (not heavy, extra-duty or high-collar). Free height (twice the thickness) is not listed in the table. An older ANSI edition (baden.html) gives slightly lower ID/OD maxima from 5/8 up; the values published here are the table that boltport, globalfastener (SAE J2655) and aftfasteners agree on. SAE J2655 and ASME B18.21.1 table 1 coincide. 24 of 37 sizes kept (sizes between standard steps and above 1-1/2 are 'additional' sizes with only 1-2 sources).

Chinese-template standards DB: globalfastener.com/standards/detail_2949.html (ASME/ANSI B18.21.1 T1-2009, 37 sizes: verifier fetched; every record row identical to the J2655 page) -> same cluster

verification.checks_done: Live re-fetch of boltport, globalfastener (detail_20069 and, new, detail_2949), aftfasteners, badensteel. Matrix 24 rows x 5 cols (A_max, A_min, B_max, T_min, W_min) x 4 clusters = 120 cells. boltport, GF and AFT agree on all 120 cells (3 clusters each); baden = 4th cluster on 56 cells (#6, #8, #10, 1/4..9/16 all cols; A_min/T_min/W_min of 5/8..1-1/2), dissents on A_max and B_max for 5/8..1-1/2 (0.640 vs 0.641, 1.072 vs 1.073, ... 1.015 vs 1.024, 1.647 vs 1.656: an older edition, 28 cells) and has a #6 thickness typo 0.31. Boltport and GF detail_2949 compared fully on 37 sizes x 6 columns: 0 differences (no discriminating typo, so independence rests on the lead's cluster rule). Headers: boltport 'Inside Diameter A Max/Min', 'Maximum Outside Diameter B', 'Minimum Mean Section Thickness (ti+to)/2 T', 'Minimum Section Width W'; AFT 'A / B / (T+t)/2 / W'; GF 'd max/min, dc max, h min, n min' (ISO-style letters, role matched by value order). Physical sanity: A_max > A_min > nominal dia, B_max > A_max, W_min > T_min, all columns monotone, W ~ (B-A)/2.
problems: No margin: 19 of 24 rows (#2,#3,#4,#5,#12 and 5/8..2) have exactly 3 clusters (boltport, GF, AFT) for every column; AFT is the only source beyond the boltport/GF pair for the 1-3/4 and 2 rows. If boltport and GF were judged to be copies (same 37-size row set incl. BW column, 0 differences), those rows would fall to 2.

The producer's GF page (detail_20069) is SAE J 2655-2015, a different standard document from the record's ASME B18.21.1 T1; numerically identical (verified on all 24 rows x 5 cols against GF's ASME B18.21.1 T1-2009 page detail_2949). Recommend citing detail_2949 in sources instead.
badensteel (older edition) contradicts A_max and B_max for 5/8..1-1/2 by 0.001-0.010 in; kept values are those of the 3 agreeing current-edition sources, but note the editions differ.
GF headers use 'h min' for mean thickness T and 'n min' for width W (not 'T'/'W'); roles verified by identical values to boltport/AFT columns, not by header text.
Row-label ambiguity: '#2' (screw size No. 2) and '2' (2 in) are different rows; consider labelling the inch row '2 in' (and similarly fractions). Strings are unique.
1-3/4 and 2 rows show T/W plateau (0.389/0.424, 0.422/0.427): matches the standard (also in boltport rows 1-5/8..2).
Producer's 'dropped' lists (11/16, 13/16, 15/16, 1-1/16, 1-3/16, 1-5/16, 1-7/16 only boltport + GF-ASME page; 1-5/8, 1-7/8, 2-1/4..3 boltport + GF) remain correctly excluded: 2 clusters.
